core_obligations: Handle g_* via the Sites back-and-forth lemma and the agreement with underlying sheaves of sets.
Compute g^{-1}g_!F(U) = g_!F(u(U)) as the double sheafification of the presheaf colimit.
Use full faithfulness to restrict the colimit to U → U' and conclude g_{p!}F(u(U)) = F(U).
Refine coverings cofinally by {u(U_i) → u(U)} and repeat the argument for the + and # steps.
proof_roadmap: Sites back-and-forth for g_* + colimit and cofinal-covering computation for g_!
difficulty_reason: Both directions fully executed: g^{-1}g_*F → F is an isomorphism by the Sites back-and-forth lemma plus agreement of pullback/pushforward of modules with the underlying sheaves of sets; for g_!, the value g^{-1}g_!F(U) = g_!F(u(U)) is computed through the double sheafification of the presheaf colimit V ↦ colim F(U'), where full faithfulness restricts the colimit to U → U' (giving g_{p!}F(u(U)) = F(U)) and the cocontinuous-continuous hypothesis refines coverings of u(U) by coverings {u(U_i) → u(U)}, a cofinal system under which both the + and the # step preserve the value F(U).
